name: omni-flash-prompting
description: Structured prompting, storyboard choreography, and prompt linter/compiler for Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash (gemini-omni-1.2-flash). Covers 3s-15s native video generation, multi-turn conversational editing, Minimal Delta + Anchor locks, up to 6 image and 3 video reference tags, audio stripping vs. preservation, and 720p-to-4K draft-to-upscale workflows.
